critical_code_review_comments: Roundtable backend is clean: all endpoints require Bearer token, seed guarded by count check so idempotent, per-user state (member/voted) resolved via db.rt_members / db.rt_votes lookups keyed by (user_id, community_id/thread_id). Correct 201 on POST for creates, 404 on unknown community/thread, 422 on validation. MongoDB _id excluded via {'_id': 0} projections and via .pop('_id', None) on freshly-inserted docs before returning — good.
Community create auto-joins creator (members=1, member=true) which is the expected UX. Reply endpoint stamps author from user.display_name so per-user attribution is correct.
Frontend uses optimistic UI for vote/join/reply with try/catch rollback via load() or restoring prior text — sound pattern. useFocusEffect on hub/community reloads on re-entry so counts stay fresh.
One place ThreadRow does an optimistic onVoted before the API call; if API fails it re-emits the *pre-optimistic* thread (thread param) so UI reverts. Correct.
